raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 90 EUR-denominated rows, including some in batch 14. silver_transactions passes their amounts through unconverted, so every gold total mixes EUR and USD. raw_fx_rates has exactly one EUR rate (1.25 to USD) and one row per currency, so amounts can be converted to USD with a join that does not duplicate rows.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(t.amount * fx.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates fx ON fx.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED';"}}
